chunks.title: Executive Summary & Core Specialization
chunks.text: Thananjayan Aruljothy is an AI Full Stack Developer specializing in building intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and modern cloud technologies. With experience developing AI-driven platforms, he works with Python Flask, OpenAI API, Claude AI, Google Gemini, ElevenLabs, AI image/video generation, and API integrations to create scalable and user-focused solutions. His expertise includes building interactive web applications using Fabric.js canvas, developing AI content creation workflows, integrating third-party AI services, and deploying applications on AWS EC2 environments. Core Skills: Python, Flask, Generative AI, LLM Integration, OpenAI API, Claude AI, Google Gemini, Fabric.js, AWS EC2, REST APIs, Salesforce.

chunks.title: Experience: Flipick - AI Full Stack Engineer (2023 - Present)
chunks.text: Flipick (April 2023 - Present, 3+ years), AI Full Stack Engineer, Jaffna, Sri Lanka. Develops AI-powered applications and intelligent content creation platforms using Python, Flask, Large Language Models (LLMs), and modern AI APIs. Designs and implements AI workflows integrating OpenAI, Claude AI, Google Gemini, ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech (TTS), and AI image/video generation services. Builds scalable backend services using Python Flask, handling AI integrations, data processing, and application logic. Develops interactive web-based editors and creative tools using Fabric.js canvas technology for AI-generated content editing and customization.

chunks.title: Experience: Flipick - Pipelines & Cloud Deployment
chunks.text: At Flipick, Thananjayan builds automated AI video generation pipelines integrating LLM-based script generation, image generation, voice synthesis, avatars, and media processing workflows. He deploys and manages applications on AWS EC2 environments (both Linux/Ubuntu and Windows), including server configuration, application deployment, and performance optimization. Collaborates with product and engineering teams to design, develop, and deliver AI-driven features for eLearning and content creation platforms with maintainable, reliable code.
